queue.title: Sales to send
queue.allSent: Everything on this till has been sent.
queue.waiting_one: {{count}} record is waiting on this till.
queue.waiting_other: {{count}} records are waiting on this till.
queue.nextAttempt: The server could not be reached. The till tries again at {{at}}.
queue.offline: The till is offline. It sends as soon as it reconnects.

blocked.session: Sending has stopped: sign in again
blocked.device: Sending has stopped: this till's enrolment was refused

queue.gaps: The server is missing till counters {{counters}}
queue.gapsBody: A sale with each of those counters was made on this shift and has not reached the server. A manager must account for it.
queue.attentionBody: Each says why below. Nothing on this till is deleted because the server refused it.
queue.emptyBody: Sales, cash movements and shifts made on this till show here until a day after the server confirms them.
queue.records: Records on this till, newest first
queue.differs: The server's total differs from the till's
queue.differsBody: The server's figure stands. Tell a manager, so the difference is looked at.
queue.printCopy: Print a copy on the printer

returns.title: A return at the counter
returns.offlineBody: A return is approved and refunded online. Connect the till.
returns.receiptNoHint: As printed on the customer's receipt.
returns.findFailed: The receipt could not be found
returns.noOrder: Receipt {{number}} has no sale to return against
returns.orderFailed: The sale could not be read
returns.nothing: Enter what is coming back on at least one item.
returns.confirmBody: The server works out the refund on these items, issues the credit note and refunds to: {{destination}}.
returns.consequence: Above the refund limit, a different person approves it before anything is refunded.
returns.pendingBody: A different person approves it. Nothing is refunded and no stock moves until then.

lock.title: This till is locked
lock.body: {{name}}’s shift. Enter your PIN to open it. It opens with or without the network.
lock.noPin: This till holds no PIN check it accepts for {{name}}, so a PIN cannot open it.

server.title: PIN locked
server.offline: The till cannot reach the server now. The PIN stays locked until {{name}} sets a new one.
server.unreached: The server could not be reached. The PIN stays locked.
server.still: The server still holds the PIN locked. {{name}} must set a new PIN, or a supervisor signs {{name}} out here so they can sign in again.

supervisor.title: Sign out the cashier
supervisor.body: A supervisor’s PIN signs {{name}} out of this till and does nothing else: it does not open the till or sell. It is recorded with the supervisor’s name and the time. The sales on this till are kept and wait to be sent. {{name}} then signs in again with their password and sets a new PIN.
supervisor.none: No supervisor on this till can sign {{name}} out with a PIN. The till stays locked until a supervisor with a PIN on this till is here.

setup.title: Set up this till
setup.body: Choose which register this device is. The till then keeps its sales and its prices on this device.
setup.noRegisters: No active register to set up
setup.registersFailed: The registers could not be read
setup.label: Name for this device
setup.labelHint: So a manager can tell the devices apart, for example Counter tablet.
setup.confirmConsequence: The device is enrolled under your name. A manager can revoke it at any time.
setup.failed: The device was not set up
setup.enrolledBody: To move it to another register, a manager revokes it in the back office and sets it up again.

printer.title: Receipt printer
printer.optional: A printer is optional. The sale is complete without one.
printer.unsupported: This browser cannot use a Bluetooth printer. Safari on iPhone and iPad has no Web Bluetooth; Chrome on Android has. The customer's receipt is the digital one.
printer.off: Bluetooth is off or missing on this device. Turn it on to print a receipt.
printer.connectFailedBody: Check it is on, near the till and not connected to another device, then try again.
printer.printFailedBody: Check it is on and has paper, then print again. The sale is complete either way.

digital.title: Digital receipt
digital.smsWaiting: An SMS with the receipt link goes to {{phone}} once the sale reaches the server.
digital.smsSent: The server has the sale, so the farm sends the receipt link by SMS to {{phone}}. The till is not told whether it arrives.
digital.smsNoLink: No SMS goes to {{phone}}: the SMS carries the receipt link, and this sale has none. Give the customer the sale reference.
digital.linkBody: The customer opens it on their own phone. It works once the sale reaches the server.
digital.noLink: This shop has no receipt link set up yet: the receipt is the one on this screen.
digital.linkLive: The server has the sale, so the link works now.
digital.linkRefused: The server refused this sale’s receipt link
digital.linkRefusedBody: The sale is recorded. Give the customer the sale reference instead.
